newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece monetary targets met in 1996 - cenbank head.
newsitem.headline: Greece monetary targets met in 1996 - cenbank head.

text.p: Greek central bank governor Lucas Papademos said the foreign exchange, money supply and credit expansion targets of the bank's monetary policy were met in 1996.
"The forex, money sypply and credit expansion targets were met," he told reporters.

Papademos said that the central bank will introduce open market operations as of February, in line with the proposed money market intervention methods of the future European central bank. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
